reason: Owner-approved critical Android Production 101070 advertising fix. An inspection of the exact released AAB confirmed that it embedded 'Pack One Dev' / development profile with extra.adMob.androidEnabled=false and no Android banner unit, so the banner could not appear at all despite a native AdMob App ID/manifest audit passing. PR #1689 (merged) fixes the Gradle runtime configuration and adds a fail-closed check of base/assets/app.config in the actual built AAB. Full Android production bundle smoke run 44594629246 passed on Nov 19, 2026 and explicitly logged 'Verified embedded AAB runtime config: production profile, Android AdMob enabled, correct banner policy.', R8 mapping and privacy audit. Build a NEW protected signed, UNPUBLISHED Android AAB candidate with the registered live Android AdMob banner ID, R8 and signing verified; DO NOT publish to Internal or Production in this build request. Publication requires a separate reviewed exact-artifact request after the signed AAB itself passes runtime verification, including its actual new version code, source SHA, signer and digest. Do not change iOS or Vercel.
